tools.title: 查看知识库
tools.description: List knowledge bases in the current App. Use the returned embedding_name for later operations.

tools.title: 查看知识库文档
tools.description: List one page of documents in a knowledge base using inclusive start and end indexes.

start.description: Optional zero-based first document index; defaults to 0.

end.description: Optional inclusive last document index; defaults to 20.

tools.title: 查看知识库任务
tools.description: List ingestion and processing tasks for one knowledge base.

tools.title: 创建知识库
tools.description: Create a text knowledge base. Choose vendor and model only from the model list; optional fields use Console defaults when omitted.

algo.description: Vector distance algorithm; COSINE is the usual default.

admin_user_ids.description: Administrators allowed to maintain this knowledge base.

max_block_size.description: Maximum tokens per document block, greater than zero.

overlapping_size.description: Overlap tokens between adjacent blocks, zero or greater.

preset_name.description: Optional Agent preset name to bind.

tools.title: 修改知识库
tools.description: Partially update a knowledge base. Omitted fields remain unchanged; empty strings and [] explicitly clear fields that accept them.

new_embedding_name.description: New name; empty string keeps the current name.

preset_name.description: Bound Agent preset name; empty string clears it.

embedding_max_tokens.description: Maximum retrieved token count, greater than zero.

embedding_max_blocks.description: Maximum retrieved block count, greater than zero.

embedding_content.description: Knowledge instruction prefix; empty string clears it.

max_block_size.description: Maximum block tokens, greater than zero.

tags.description: Complete tag definition list; [] clears tags.

tools.title: 添加公开知识来源
tools.description: Add a public URL or website to a knowledge base. type=url requires url; type=site requires url or at least one item in urls. Local files are not supported by this runtime.

type.description: url for one public page or site for a crawl.

url.description: Public HTTP or HTTPS source URL.

urls.description: Public starting URLs for a site crawl.

filters.description: URL path filters; [] means no filters.

max_depth.description: Maximum crawl depth, zero or greater.

generate_lanying_links.description: Whether to generate BlueLink content for discovered pages.

tools.title: 继续知识库任务
tools.description: Continue one stopped or incomplete knowledge ingestion task after reading its current status.

tools.title: 重新处理知识库文档
tools.description: Reprocess one existing knowledge document after reading its failed state.

tools.title: 重新处理全部知识文档
tools.description: Reprocess every document in one knowledge base; this can consume substantial model capacity.
